title.id: Zenith 2.0: badge faksi & tombol START GAME ikut diterjemahkan
title.en: Zenith 2.0: faction badges & START GAME button translated

id: Badge faksi di kartu (Sunset, Central Plains, Riverlands, Three Kingdoms, Zhulu Plateau) dan tombol START GAME di lobi kini ikut diterjemahkan.
Fitur ini HANYA untuk Zenith Launcher 2.0. Launcher 1.9.x tetap memakai data terjemahan sebelumnya: perbarui ke 2.0 untuk mendapatkannya.
Unduhan data bahasa naik menjadi +-123 MB (berisi selisih gambar, bukan paket gambar 900 MB).
Pulihkan Data juga mengembalikan gambar asli tanpa unduh ulang.
Cocok dengan data game 1.8.0.1. Setelah game di-update sampai lobi, cukup tekan Suntik Data.
en: Faction badges on cards (Sunset, Central Plains, Riverlands, Three Kingdoms, Zhulu Plateau) and the lobby START GAME button are now translated.
This feature is for Zenith Launcher 2.0 ONLY. Launcher 1.9.x keeps the previous translation data: update to 2.0 to get it.
The language data download grows to about 123 MB (it carries image differences, not the 900 MB image packages).
Restore Data also brings back the original images without re-downloading.
Matches game data 1.8.0.1. After updating the game to the lobby, just press Inject Data.
